articles.author: Shomik Sen Bhattacharjee
articles.headline: Maria Sharapova Once Revealed Her 'Steely Mentality' Made People Uncomfortable— It Also Built a Tennis Dynasty and a Portfolio of Winning Bets
articles.summary: Tennis great Maria Sharapova refused to apologize for her ruthless mentality on the court and carried that discipline into business ventures.
articles._summary: Speaking with Gayle King at the TIME100 Summit in New York earlier this year, Sharapova said she never wanted to reshape herself to meet others’ expectations. "So from a young age, I had a very steely mentality. I had a fist pump that I was really known for," she said. After matches, people told her, "‘It’s so intimidating. You need to soften your edges. Can you add a filter?’" Sharapova said she felt pressure to apologize "because I was a lady," but rejected it.
articles._zh_headline: 玛丽亚·莎拉波娃曾透露她的“钢铁心态”让人不舒服——它还建立了一个网球王朝和一系列获胜赌注
articles._zh_summary: 今年早些时候，莎拉波娃在纽约举行的 TIME100 峰会上与盖尔·金 (Gayle King) 交谈时表示，她从来不想为了满足别人的期望而重塑自己。 “所以从很小的时候起，我就有一种非常钢铁般的心态。我的拳头泵是我真正出名的，”她说。赛后，人们告诉她，“‘这太吓人了。你需要软化你的棱角。你能加个过滤器吗？’”莎拉波娃说，她感到有压力道歉，“因为我是一位女士”，但她拒绝了。

articles._summary: The best inflation report of 2026 landed on Wall Street this week, and the market sold anyway, abandoning the semiconductor trade that has carried the entire rally for three years. articles.author: Parshwa Turakhiya
articles.headline: Bitcoin Breaks Tech Stocks Correlation: Will BTC Now Follow in Gold's Footsteps?
articles.summary: Bitcoin ETFs may be following gold’s boom-bust cycle, with IBIT’s pullback signaling a long recovery before the next record high.
articles._summary: Bloomberg Senior ETF Analyst Eric Balchunas on Friday said Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) ETFs are likely following gold ETFs’ 22-year playbook of explosive gains, painful drawdowns, and recoveries that test investor patience. Balchunas built his comparison around one shared structural trait. Both Bitcoin and gold ETFs are wrappers around non-yielding assets that generate no cash flow, meaning investor sentiment drives performance rather than earnings, coupons, or government backing.
articles._zh_headline: 比特币打破了科技股的相关性：比特币现在会追随黄金的脚步吗？
articles._zh_summary: 彭博社高级 ETF 分析师埃里克·巴尔丘纳斯 (Eric Balchunas) 周五表示，比特币 (CRYPTO: BTC) ETF 很可能会效仿黄金 ETF 22 年的做法：爆炸性上涨、痛苦回撤和复苏，考验投资者的耐心。巴尔丘纳斯围绕一个共同的结构特征进行了比较。比特币和黄金 ETF 都是不产生现金流的非收益资产的包装，这意味着投资者情绪驱动业绩，而不是收益、优惠券或政府支持。
